senses.gloss:
शबल śabála, a. spotted, brindled, variegated 🞄(V., C.);
 mixed, provided, or filled with 🞄(—˚, C.): -tā, f., -tva, n. mixture.

शबली śabalī́, f. cow of plenty (nm. id. 🞄or -s;
 V.).

शब्दाय śabdā-ya, den. Ā. sound;
 cry, yell, 🞄bray.

शब्दित śabdita, pp. of śabdaya;
 n. cry.
शाबरिका śābar-ikā, f. kind of leech (conj.).
शाबरी śābarī, f. language of the Śabaras.
शाबल्य śābal-ya, n. [śabala] mixture, medley 🞄(P., very rare).
सबर्दुघ sabar-dúgha, a. yielding milk readily 🞄(cow, RV.).
साबाध sa‿ābādha, a. suffering, ailing.
